subject: Vendor master onboarding: Ardent Fabric — legal identity & PO contact
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Karen Mills <karen.mills@ardentfabric.com>, Accounts Payable <ap@ardentfabric.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor master intake — Ardent Fabric (legal info + PO contact)

Hi Karen —

Thanks for taking the time to start vendor onboarding with Redwood. To get Ardent Fabric set up in our vendor master and enable PO issuance, could you confirm the following items and attach any supporting docs (W-9, bank authorization, certificate of insurance if available):

• Legal entity name (exact as registered)
• Tax ID / EIN
• Entity type (Corporation / LLC / Sole proprietorship)
• Registered / remit address (line1, city, state, zip, country)
• Primary AP / PO contact name, title, email and phone
• Remit-to email for invoices and preferred invoice format (PDF / EDI)
• Bank account holder name for ACH, bank routing and account numbers (or an ACH authorization form)

For convenience, here’s a short onboarding form you can use to upload docs: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScOnboardingFormExample

If you prefer, reply to this thread with attachments. Once we receive the materials I’ll route to AP for verification and request vendor ID creation — typical turnaround ~24–48 hrs (sooner if the W-9 matches our validation).

Thanks — look forward to getting this live.

Jonas Weber
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor master intake — Ardent Fabric (legal info + PO contact)

Jonas / Laura —

Quick internal note after reviewing Karen's submission:

• EIN and legal name match the attached W-9 — good to proceed from a tax validation perspective.
• ACH authorization is on company letterhead and signed; AP will still require micro-deposit verification before we enable live ACH payments.
• No COI provided; for now this is fine for standard supplier spend, but if a contract includes goods with installation at customer sites we should request COI (I can flag in SOW review).
• I attached a short redline to our standard procurement terms where Ardent requested a net-60 payment term. We should not accept net-60 for initial orders; propose net-30 with a 30-day review after two invoices. (see redline_terms_jonas.docx)

Action items for Jonas: can you confirm whether Ardent requests any special PO routing (e.g., a specific PO approver name) beyond Maria Lopez? Also, please ask them for a sample invoice PDF so AP can validate header fields against our payments schema.

Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Payments & Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Hi Karen / AP team —

Thanks — we received the W-9 and ACH authorization and ran the initial checks. Vendor master record has been created in our system. Details below: 

• Vendor ID: ARD-2379
• Legal name: Ardent Fabric Inc.
• Remit email: invoices@ardentfabric.com
• Primary PO contact: Maria Lopez — maria.lopez@ardentfabric.com

Next steps: 
1) AP will do micro-deposits to the submitted bank account; please confirm once you see them so we can enable ACH payments.
2) If you can reply with a sample invoice PDF (one page with invoice header, PO number field, remit email and tax ID), AP will validate formatting and onboarding will be finalized.
3) We have not accepted net-60 on the initial profile — our standard terms will be net-30; Kimberly has attached proposed redlines. If you want to escalate payment terms, we can review after two invoices.

I’ve attached the vendor master record export for your reference and a link to the vendor portal where you can upload invoices and check PO status: https://redwood.example.com/vendor/portal/ARD-2379

Attachments: Vendor_Master_Record.pdf

If anything changes on your side (different remit email or AP contact), reply here and we’ll update the profile.

Thanks all —
